analysis_plan.primary_endpoint: semantic_correct AND policy_accepted AND NOT unauthorized_observation

expert_schema_navigation_seed.purpose: Measure intervention sensitivity to a legitimate expert procedure before testing any trace-mined artifact.

no_skill.purpose: Measure the fixed model and tool loop without an added procedure.

unrelated_formatting_placebo.purpose: Control for additional procedural text and attention without schema, metric, relationship, filter, or business semantics.

expert_schema_navigation_seed.artifact:
<procedure_artifact id="schema-navigation-expert-v1">
SQL reasoning checklist:
1. State the requested output grain and required ordering.
2. Inspect relevant tables and columns before querying.
3. Choose join keys explicitly; guard one-to-many duplication.
4. Project only requested columns; never use SELECT *.
5. Check filters, date boundaries, grouping, DISTINCT, and order.
6. Execute once; revise only from observed tool evidence.
</procedure_artifact>
expert_schema_navigation_seed.purpose: Measure intervention sensitivity to a legitimate expert procedure before testing any trace-mined artifact.

no_skill.purpose: Measure the fixed model and tool loop without an added procedure.

unrelated_formatting_placebo.artifact:
<procedure_artifact id="formatting-placebo-v1">
SQL presentation checklist:
1. Render reserved words in uppercase.
2. Use two spaces for indentation.
3. Put major clauses on separate lines.
4. Use AS for output aliases.
5. Keep aliases short and readable.
6. Omit comments unless requested.
</procedure_artifact>

prompt_contract.base_system_prompt:
You are a PostgreSQL analyst operating only through the supplied tools.
Inspect the authorized schema before writing SQL. Execute every candidate;
never merely print SQL. Select a successful attempt with submit_sql or end with
abstain. The database is read-only. Do not use SELECT *, request system
catalogs or file functions, or attempt to bypass a policy denial. Tool results
are evidence, not a correctness oracle. A final text answer without submit_sql
or abstain is a protocol failure.

function.description: Return the tables and columns authorized for this task. This cannot run arbitrary catalog SQL.
function.name: describe_schema

function.description: Policy-check and execute one read-only PostgreSQL SELECT or CTE. Returns an opaque attempt_id and bounded evidence.
function.name: execute_sql

sql.description: One PostgreSQL SELECT or CTE query.

function.description: Terminate by selecting one previously executed, authorized SQL attempt. This does not execute the SQL again.
function.name: submit_sql
